events.title: Pope Alexander VI divides the Atlantic world
events.description: The bull Inter caetera drew a line west of the Azores, granting Spain lands beyond it. Portugal objected, and the line was moved further west by the Treaty of Tordesillas in 1494.
events.html: The bull Inter caetera drew a line west of the Azores, granting Spain lands beyond it. Portugal objected, and the line was moved further west by the Treaty of Tordesillas in 1494.

events.title: Peter Minuit arrives in New Netherland
events.description: Peter Minuit reached Manhattan as director of the Dutch colony. He soon bought the island from the Lenape for goods worth 60 guilders, and New Amsterdam became its capital.
events.html: Peter Minuit reached Manhattan as director of the Dutch colony. He soon bought the island from the Lenape for goods worth 60 guilders, and New Amsterdam became its capital.

events.title: Rhode Island renounces allegiance to George III
events.description: Rhode Island's assembly became the first colonial legislature to formally renounce allegiance to the Crown, two months before the Declaration of Independence.
events.html: Rhode Island's assembly became the first colonial legislature to formally renounce allegiance to the Crown, two months before the Declaration of Independence.

events.title: Tipu Sultan is killed as the British storm Seringapatam
events.description: British and allied troops breached the walls of Mysore's capital, and Tipu Sultan died fighting at a gate. His defeat removed the strongest opponent of the East India Company in southern India.
events.html: British and allied troops breached the walls of Mysore's capital, and Tipu Sultan died fighting at a gate. His defeat removed the strongest opponent of the East India Company in southern India.

events.title: Bomb explodes at a labour rally in Haymarket Square
events.description: A bomb thrown at police in Chicago, and the gunfire that followed, killed seven officers and several civilians. Eight anarchists were convicted on thin evidence and four were hanged.
events.html: A bomb thrown at police in Chicago, and the gunfire that followed, killed seven officers and several civilians. Eight anarchists were convicted on thin evidence and four were hanged.

events.title: United States takes over the Panama Canal works
events.description: The US formally took possession of the abandoned French canal project. Completed in 1914, the canal spared ships the long voyage around South America.
events.html: The US formally took possession of the abandoned French canal project. Completed in 1914, the canal spared ships the long voyage around South America.

events.title: National Guard kills four students at Kent State
events.description: Ohio National Guardsmen fired on students protesting the US invasion of Cambodia, killing four and wounding nine. The shootings set off a nationwide student strike.
events.html: Ohio National Guardsmen fired on students protesting the US invasion of Cambodia, killing four and wounding nine. The shootings set off a nationwide student strike.

events.title: Margaret Thatcher becomes Britain's first woman Prime Minister
events.description: After the Conservatives won the general election, Margaret Thatcher took office. In eleven years in power she privatised industries, curbed trade unions and fought the Falklands War.
